items.text: Hi SLAVS!!!
Finally, we can bring you some news and NEW CONTENT.

MAIN NEWS : a COMPLETELY FREE NEW MISSION — "SLAVS IN AMERICA", which continues the storyline of the main campaign. We're diving headfirst into our patented brand of insanity and sending the Rus brothers to the Slavic States of America to finally settle the long-standing issue with the PEACEDEAL between rus and lizards. You'll face 2 new reused animations bosses, along with brand-new explosive dialogues and battles! The mission unlocks immediately after the previous one, "Yashurmor" (which you can also play if you somehow missed it).

Moreover, LIZARDS MUST DIE 2 is now available on consoles! Happy PS and Xbox owners who have been waiting for two whole years for a chance to play since PC release in 2025, HERE IT IS. Go ahead and ENJOY THE MASTERPEACE!
We've named all this content as LIZARDS MUST DIE FULL PACK FULL GOYDA TURBO COMPLETE EDITION and released a ULTRA-FASHIONABLE TRAILER.

Brothers, we have came upwith the first hotfix and we continue to work on issues:
Now they fall less often, and if they fall, they die.
At the Baikal level, they should stop falling underground altogether, checked on several devices.

notes.title: Red screen on laptops with integrated or missing graphics cards

items.text: Go to settings, click video settings, click FIX RED SCREEN
Who doesn't have this problem, DON'T CLICK

notes.title: Game crashes almost immediately after launch

items.text: If the graphics card is from NVIDIA, then you need to check if FSR is enabled in the settings, if the card is from AMD, then you need to turn off DLSS.
It can also help to run the game in windowed mode, if the point above does not help.
Added regions. Now it is better to choose a region by location (Europe, Asia, America, China).

Unfortunately, our network engine is not native, NOT OURS, so it's the hardest to fight with it. If you can't connect for more than a minute, you can try closing the game and run it again, which usually helps.
If the above methods do not help, you can go to the multiplayer-europe branch, the guide is in discussion panel on Steam.
Some Internet service providers may still have problems logging out of the coop mode.
At the Baikal level, you can now ride in Hardcore cart mode
Dynamite no longer causes damage toheroes
The tank's health has been slightly reduced
The brightness slider is now working
Fixed a bug with the choice of characters after the cutscene with pyaterochka
Fixed a bug with Mstislav's scarecrow (it no longer remains in the hand when dying and taking damage).
If any other bugs occurs, write us, we will be in touch!
